entries.note: The parcel's data, before TopYou's first-mile scan.

entries.wording: Arrived at the first mile sorting center
entries.note: The first scan in TopYou's hands, at its warehouse in China.

entries.wording: Departed from the first mile sorting center
Arrived at airport of the original country
Departed from Airport to destination country

entries.note: Released by the destination country's customs. The tracker leaves the country after "of" empty, which the adapter drops.

entries.wording: At U.S. Postal Service facility, Accepted by U.S. Postal Service
entries.note: USPS takes the parcel over from TopYou's line in the United States, after the flight; it is no first acceptance.
The first scan in TopYou's hands, worded for its newer waybills.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at a carrier facility
entries.note: Under the code for leaving the first-mile warehouse, after TopYou received the parcel: movement, not its acceptance.

entries.wording: Shipment started the customs clearance process at origin
entries.note: Export clearance before the flight, a routine step, not a hold.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived in the destination country
Shipment started the customs clearance process at destination
entries.note: Import clearance, under the code for arriving in the destination country.

entries.wording: Shipment completed the customs clearance process at destination
entries.note: Cleared and on its way to the delivery carrier, not held in customs.

The hand-over to the delivering carrier: to GOFO in France and Italy at GOFO's first sorting-centre scan, days before GOFO's delivery round ("The driver is out for delivery"), and to iMile in Germany after the clearance, hours before iMile's first scan.

entries.wording: Arrived at GOFO Regional Destination Facility
entries.note: GOFO's arrival at its regional depot, relayed at the second of GOFO's own scan.

entries.wording: The driver is out for delivery
entries.note: GOFO's delivery round, relayed at the second of GOFO's own scan.

entries.wording: In Transit, Your order has been shipped from 【iMile Köln DC Center】.
entries.note: iMile's scan in Germany, relayed after iMile's label for its step; iMile's map stages the sentence.

entries.wording: Delivery, Your order has arrived at 【Dortmund01】
entries.note: iMile's arrival at its delivery station.

entries.wording: Delivery, Your order has assigned delivery drvier.
entries.note: iMile names the driver before the parcel leaves the station; the misspelling is iMile's.

entries.wording: Delivery, Our delivery associate is out for delivery.
entries.note: iMile's delivery round.
GOFO's sorting scan after the hand-over, relayed like GOFO's other scans.
GOFO's sorting scan after the hand-over.
GOFO's sorting scan after the hand-over.
The first scan in TopYou's hands on a line a post delivers, worded in that line's vocabulary.
Booked in at the first-mile warehouse, as code 5 says, minutes after the acceptance: not yet movement.
Out of the first-mile warehouse. The tracker appends ", Lastmile Number:" and the delivery carrier's number, which the map leaves aside.

entries.wording: Airline arrived at transit country or district.
Airline departed from transit or district country.

entries.note: Cleared for export, not held.
Cleared by the destination's customs for the delivery carrier, a post here; the post's own customs scans can follow.
The destination's import clearance, minutes after the hand-over to the last-mile carrier, under the code TopYou gives every scan up to the delivery.

entries.wording: Arrived, The parcel has been delivered to 【】. Please collect your parcel promptly at 【】 using your pickup code. If you have any questions, please contact the pickup point at 【】.
entries.note: The pickup point's notice that the parcel waits for its pickup code; the tracker may leave the point's name out of the brackets or fill it in.
DPD's arrival at its delivery depot in Austria (DPD Austria's IN_DEPOT), relayed after the hand-over at DPD's own instant.
DPD's delivery round in Austria (IN_DELIVERY).

entries.wording: Unfortunately, consignee not present. Notification was left.
entries.note: DPD's missed delivery in Austria (NAB/NABN): nobody was in and a card was left.

entries.wording: Parcel was handed over to Pickup parcel shop
entries.note: DPD's driver left the parcel at a Pickup parcelshop after the missed delivery (HANDOVER/SHOP).
The Pickup parcelshop booked the parcel in for the recipient (TAKEOVER/SHOP).
The delivering partner's transit scan in Spain after the destination's customs, relayed on the partner's clock.
The recipient did not collect the parcel from the Pickup parcelshop in time (NOT_PICKED_UP); DPD sends it back to the sender, which its next scan states.
